name: opencodex
install:
set -euo pipefail
BUN_VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .bun-version)"
if [ "$BUN_VERSION" != "1.4.3" ]; then
  echo "opencodex: .bun-version is ${BUN_VERSION}; install pins bun-v1.4.3" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$BUN_VERSION"; then
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.4.3"
fi
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
sudo -n ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
sudo -n ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bunx
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd gui
(cd gui && bun run build)
start:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:10100/healthz 2>/dev/null |
  bun -e 'const body = await Bun.stdin.json().catch(() => null); process.exit(body && !Array.isArray(body) && body.status === "ok" && body.service === "opencodex" ? 0 : 1)'; then
  exit 0
fi
exec bun run src/cli/index.ts start --port 10100 --proxy-only
